name: Baotailong New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Baotailong New Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides new materials, advanced carbon materials, coal chemical products, hydrogen fuel, and urban public services in China. It offers reduced graphene oxide powder, graphene powder as a coating additive, graphene oxide powder and slurry, conductive additive type graphene powder and slurry, graphene slurry additive for coatings, graphene heating film, graphene silicon crystal far-infrared electric heater, graphene intelligent heating and uterine protection, graphene far-infrared electric heating mural, and graphene smart heated vest, as well as graphene smart heating knee pad, neck protector, waist support, and scroll paint…
